payload.claim: `set_task_package`'s docstring still asserts "the state it sets is the last word on the task (§5.7)" — but this very change adds `reconcile()`, which writes `MERGED`, `REJECTED`, or `CHANGES_REQUESTED` over a `READY_FOR_REVIEW`/`CHANGES_REQUESTED` row well after PACKAGE ran. The docstring is left asserting exactly the false invariant that `docs/BACKLOG.md`'s own entry #27 (added by this diff) says was the whole defect: "the ledger's last word was always READY_FOR_REVIEW." Nothing else in `saffron/` reads this comment, so nothing breaks today, but the next engineer to touch `Ledger` is told a promise this diff itself falsifies.
